mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
l.loan_purpose, l.target_group, l.min_age, l.max_age, l.income_basis, l.max_income, l.application_channel, l.max_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN loan l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'LOAN'
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
l.loan_purpose, l.target_group, l.min_age, l.max_age, l.income_basis, l.max_income, l.application_channel, l.max_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN loan l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.product_type = 'LOAN'

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
l.loan_purpose, l.target_group, l.min_age, l.max_age, l.income_basis, l.max_income, l.application_channel, l.max_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN loan l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'LOAN' AND l.loan_purpose = #{loanPurpose}
ORDER BY l.max_rate, p.id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
l.loan_purpose, l.target_group, l.min_age, l.max_age, l.income_basis, l.max_income, l.application_channel, l.max_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN loan l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.product_type = 'LOAN' AND l.target_group = #{targetGroup}
ORDER BY l.max_rate, p.id
